reason: Primary purpose is a DeepSeek Harness web GUI navigation enhancement: a sidebar panel that lists per-message conversation anchors and lets users jump to specific chat turns by smooth scrolling. The plugin is client-side and UI-focused, with no indicated external integrations or command execution.

capabilities: Generates a sidebar anchor list for visible chat turns
Subscribes to session snapshot updates to refresh anchor data in real time
Injects UI elements into DSH web sidebar via DOM-level insertion and MutationObserver re-heal
Performs click-to-scroll navigation to conversation DOM anchors

reasons.code: README states the plugin is an out-of-tree browser-side sidebar extension that adds anchor navigation for conversation nodes.
The behavior is implemented on the client side for platform "web" and depends on DOM markers like [data-chat-anchor-key], indicating UI/DOM manipulation scope.
It supports DeepSeek Harness web GUI only and notes DOM compatibility dependence, implying potential layout fragility if host DOM changes.
